fr:title.text: Audit and clean up forest references

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Audit and clean up forest references

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Audit of all 160 reference trees in trees/public/refs/ as of 2026-05-29. Goal: every reference should point to a published source (or be clearly marked preprint), with an official PDF cached locally when possible.

Baseline. 160 reference trees; 94 PDFs in assets/pdfs/; only 19 entries live in references.bib — the other 141 carry their bibtex inline via , so they are hand-maintained and not regenerated by utils/split_bib.py.

html:ul.html:li: Healthy: 58. PUBLISHED_PDF_OFFICIAL — real venue DOI, PDF cached, URL is not arxiv. Nothing to do.
Published, missing PDF: 63. PUBLISHED_NO_PDF — real venue DOI/booktitle but nothing in assets/pdfs/. Mix of paywalled and freely available; books in this bucket should be left alone.

html:li.html:strong: Cached PDF is the arxiv preprint, not the camera-ready: 15.

html:ul.html:li: PUBLISHED_PDF_LIKELY_PREPRINT (11): SterlingAnguiliNormalization, amorim_etal_2021_lics, giovannini_ding_new_2025, goelSymmetryQuantificationNew2021, grathwohl_infinitary_2013, jiang_xue_new_2025, moutonStrideTranslationInvariance2020, mullerPRIMAGeneralPrecise2022, new_ahmed_2018, new_licata_2023, new_licata_ahmed_2019.
PUBLISHED_PDF_LINKS_ARXIV (4): amorim_kura_saville_2025, grothendieck_1971 (SGA-4 — arxiv copy is fine), hirsch_etal_2020, new_licata_2020_lmcs (LMCS is OA — fine to keep arxiv).

ARXIV_PDF_NO_VENUE (6, DOI is 10.48550/arXiv.*): azulayWhyDeepConvolutional, berry_fiore_2025, gavranovicFundamentalComponentsDeep, kouvarosFormalVerificationCNNbased2018, seshiaVerifiedArtificialIntelligence2020, tranVerificationDeepConvolutional2020.

ARXIV_ONLY (8): alexandruIntrinsicallyCorrectAlgorithms2025-preprint, amorim_lam_2022, depaiva-eades-jiang-2019-lambek-exchange, depaiva2018-dialectica-lambek, fu2023twolevellineardependenttype, li_etal_2025, myburghTrackingTranslationInvariance2021, vakarSyntaxSemanticsLinear2015.

Other preprints / tagged as preprint but actually published: 9. PREPRINT_OTHER: Johnsonyacc (1975 tech report), agda, cubicalagdalib, angus2001kleene, amorim_effcost, amorim_hsu_independent, and three USENIX papers that need bibtex upgrades: hanceFindingInvariantsDistributed (NSDI '21), maSiftUsingRefinementguided (ATC '22), yaoDistAIDataDrivenAutomated (OSDI '21).
No bibtex block: 1. jesper1001 — blog post, needs either a @misc block or removal of taxon{Reference}.

html:ol.html:li: Replace 11 arxiv-shadow PDFs with camera-readies (PUBLISHED_PDF_LIKELY_PREPRINT). Each has a real venue DOI; download the official version and update assets/pdfs/.
Upgrade the three USENIX entries (hance..., ma...Sift, yao...DistAI) from @article with a USENIX URL to proper @inproceedings with booktitle/year/DOI.
Search for venue versions of the 8 ARXIV_ONLY entries. Check DBLP/Google Scholar/author pages. Some are confirmed preprints (filename ending in -preprint); leave those.
Backfill PDFs for the 63 PUBLISHED_NO_PDF entries, best-effort. Easy wins first: LMCS / EPTCS / LIPIcs / dl.acm.org open-access. Skip books and irrecoverable paywalls.
(Optional) consolidate references.bib — feed the 141 inline bibtex blocks back into the bib file and run split_bib.py, so there is one source of truth.

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Raw audit data: /tmp/audit.csv and /tmp/refined.txt from the 2026-05-29 audit session.
